summary.intent: Fix two bugs: (1) SDK uploadFile hardcodes AES-GCM and never activates the CTR streaming pipeline for large media files, and (2) BYO-IPFS load tests returning 400/403 errors on staging due to missing BYO mode setup and incorrect IPNS publish payload.
summary.outcome: Both bugs fixed and merged. PR #399 wired CTR encryption through the SDK with centralized MIME type detection. PR #400 added a PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint (setByoStatus was dead code), fixed the load test IPNS publish payload, and fixed ~9 API test files with systemic mock typing issues.

repo: setByoStatus() existed as a VaultService method but had no controller endpoint — BYO mode could never be toggled via API, making all register-cid calls return 403 regardless of user intent
SDK selectEncryptionMode() was only called on the duplicate-file re-encrypt path, never for new uploads — the CTR streaming pipeline was completely unreachable for new uploads
The load test's ipns-publish step was sending { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } with a signed IPNS record — the fields were entirely wrong
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — centralized to packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts
audio/flac was missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both locations
The pnpm api:generate script's lint:fix step lints the entire repo including target/ (Rust build artifacts) causing spurious failures unrelated to TypeScript changes
orval generation creates model files that must all be staged — partial staging of api-client/src/ causes CI drift check failures
A duplicate todo file (both pending/ and done/) was introduced during the merge because the branch added the done/ copy while main already had the pending/ copy
.husky/commit-msg and .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire are managed by the Entire CLI tool locally and should be in .git/info/exclude to avoid polluting git diffs

code.finding: New centralized module for selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode() — single source of truth for CTR vs GCM selection
Added optional encryptionMode param; uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when mode is CTR, falls back to GCM
uploadFile now calls selectEncryptionMode from sdk-core before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added; VaultService.setByoStatus() was previously unreachable dead code
createByoClientPool now enables BYO mode on each account after creation via the new endpoint; filters out failed accounts and throws if zero succeed
Fixed ipns-publish step to use createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core instead of sending raw incorrect fields; hoisted createSdkContext outside the per-iteration loop
vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core', () => ({ ... })) bare factory pattern drops all real exports when new ones are added — must use importOriginal + spread pattern

workflow: Using importOriginal + spread in vitest mocks (vi.mock with async factory) prevents fragility when new exports are added to a module — bare factory factories drop everything not explicitly listed
jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> loses mock method types after module.get() in NestJS test modules — use the mock object directly instead of getting from module to retain typed mock methods
When adding a new export to a shared package, all test files that use a bare vi.mock factory for that package need updating simultaneously — CI will catch missed files
git add of specific files during api-client regeneration is fragile — always stage the entire src/ directory of generated packages to avoid drift
When orval generates new model files for new API endpoints, they must all be committed together with the openapi.json; partial commits cause barrel file (models/index.ts) import errors in CI

friction: The accidental openapi.json written to apps/api/ (wrong location) instead of packages/api-client/ required a cleanup commit
sdk-core build output being stale caused sdk typecheck to fail until a rebuild was done — the types are from compiled output not source
GraphQL API for fetching PR review threads timed out, requiring a fallback to REST API
Five SDK test files all needed the same vi.mock fix, discovered one at a time via CI rather than all at once
pnpm api:generate lint:fix step lints Rust target/ build artifacts causing noisy errors unrelated to the changes being made
Partial git staging of api-client changes caused a CI drift check failure requiring a follow-up commit
The .husky/commit-msg file managed by Entire CLI kept appearing in git diffs; required investigation to understand the pre-entire chain and ultimately needed .git/info/exclude entries
open_items: The BYO-IPFS load test ipns-publish step now uses createAndPublishIpnsRecord but staging load test baselines (todo #11) still pending
Todo #6: Investigate removal of mock-ipns-routing layer (api area) still pending
Todo #13 (Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors) was worked in this session but actual staging validation/baselines not run — the fix addresses root causes but staging confirmation deferred
The delegated-routing.client.spec.ts has a lingering @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any warning from the SpyInstance cast fix
integration.test.ts in packages/sdk hits a live API endpoint and fails in CI — pre-existing issue not addressed
The web app Settings UI path for enabling BYO mode should be validated end-to-end now that the PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint exists
